reuse: Container layout cross-check only. No upstream code copied; independent bounded Python parser/remuxer remains project MIT.
verified_offline: BIKi audio metadata is three per-track 4-byte arrays before frame offsets.
Each frame stores one LE32 packet length plus packet bytes for each audio track, then video bytes.
Original metadata and per-frame compressed audio packets survive identity strip/remux byte-for-byte on all eleven worldmap movies.
limitations: Only BIKi, flags0, <=6144 frames, <=8 audio tracks and bounded geometry supported; the legacy silent-caption builder still defaults to 600 frames unless the plan explicitly opts in.
Packet preservation and offline decode do not establish game runtime or visual acceptance.
